opportunities.title: Holiday spot, Target and Best Buy aisles
opportunities.what_is_happening: e.l.f.'s first holiday spot, 'Made to Stand Out', runs on digital, social and TV-section takeovers at Best Buy and Target through the holiday season.
opportunities.why_flowcode: The in-aisle spot reaches shoppers but has no scan path, so no store-level attribution or first-party capture.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand release plus wire; TV case, different category.
opportunities.size_why: National Target and Best Buy footprint plus social.
opportunities.timing_why: Runs through holiday season; screen creative still swappable.
opportunities.suggested_play: Add an end-card Flowcode to the in-aisle spot, unique per retailer, opening a holiday gift FlowHub with shop links and email sign-up. Compare scans by store and retailer.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the media lead who controls in-store screen creative at Target and Best Buy.

play.name: Scannable TV and broadcast spots
play.play: Put a Flowcode in the spot that leads to shop, content or a sweepstakes. Use analytics to see which creative and which network drove scans, then shift media spend.

products.name: Analytics & Integrations
products.page_quote: Real-time analytics that feed directly into your tech stack
products.what_it_does: Real-time dashboards, a Conversion Pixel for full-funnel attribution, SmartFlow (AI-driven optimization of landing experiences), and integrations with HubSpot, Salesforce, Snowflake, Adobe, Mailchimp, Zapier, Okta and Microsoft 365.
products.use_when: The brand spends heavily on offline media (TV, OOH, retail, sponsorships) and cannot measure which placements or creative drive results.

case_study.what_they_did: Flowcodes inside a TV broadcast spot sent viewers straight to the NFL Shop store to buy.

opportunities.title: NWSL, Spurs Women and fair pop-ups
opportunities.what_is_happening: e.l.f. returns to the NWSL Championship Fan Fest, renewed its Tottenham Hotspur Women shirt sponsorship, and ran state fair pop-ups.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Fan Fest, pop-ups and sponsorship assets draw crowds but capture no first-party contacts for e.l.f.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand-owned announcements; sports case, different category.
opportunities.size_why: US league final plus UK club season; multi-market.
opportunities.timing_why: Spurs mid-season; NWSL final imminent; fair pop-ups ended.
opportunities.suggested_play: Put Flowcodes on Fan Fest booths, Glow For Glory entry and Spurs matchday assets leading to a contest FlowHub. Smart Rules block duplicates; FlowID keeps each fan as e.l.f.'s contact.
opportunities.first_step: Pitch Spurs Women matchday codes now; propose codes for the next fair pop-up tour.

play.name: Event and sponsorship capture

opportunities.title: e.l.f. POP holiday packs, next run
opportunities.what_is_happening: e.l.f. POP, its first fragrance and body care line, debuted with limited-edition Tromsø holiday packaging; Beauty Squad rewards retail purchases via receipt upload.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Packs carry no scan path, and retail buyers reach Beauty Squad only through manual receipt uploads.
opportunities.confidence_why: Brand-owned sources; packaging case, different category.
opportunities.size_why: New line from a national brand; limited edition.
opportunities.timing_why: Holiday packs already printed; pitch next limited run.
opportunities.suggested_play: Put a Flowcode on the next POP limited-edition pack opening a FlowHub with scent content and a giveaway; FlowID enrolls scanners into Beauty Squad with CRM sync.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the POP brand manager when the next limited-edition packaging brief locks.

opportunities.title: Roblox and ZEPETO link attribution
opportunities.what_is_happening: Glow Up! on Roblox has 12 million-plus visits with new Kuromi content through the holidays; e.l.f. also launched a ZEPETO styling experience.
opportunities.why_flowcode: Game and social traffic is not tied to the same identity as e.l.f.'s offline touchpoints.
opportunities.confidence_why: Wire sources; link fit plausible, game channel unproven.
opportunities.timing_why: Holiday content still being added; links changeable anytime.
opportunities.suggested_play: Route Glow Up! and ZEPETO calls to action through FlowURLs to a shared FlowHub, so game players and in-store scanners resolve to one FlowID profile.
opportunities.first_step: Ask the digital lead how Glow Up! traffic is attributed to sales today.

play.name: Branded links for social and creators
play.play: Use FlowURLs in creator and social posts that lead to the same FlowHub and FlowID as the offline touchpoints, so the brand can attribute digital and physical activity to the same people.
